etymology.historical_story: Hauser belongs to a surname tradition in which housing, occupation and place of origin could distinguish families. Onomastic references connect different bearers' names with household roles, residences, or places named Haus and Hausen. These are alternative historical pathways, not a single biography shared by everyone called Hauser. Malay normally preserves the inherited surname rather than translating its historical components. [Surname reference](https://www.cbgfamilienamen.nl/nfb/detail_naam.php?gba_naam=h%C3%A4user&info=documentatie&nfd_naam=Hauser&operator=rx&taal=ja%2F%40ken_tbdz)
